name: Bind
text: Roots one big enemy or boss for a few seconds.

name: Hurl
note: Always has rubble to throw; the design needs loose objects in the room.
text: Throws loose rubble in the room at enemies.

name: Maelstrom
note: The whirlpool draws foes in and hurts them; it does not pull loose parts of yours too.
text: A whirlpool that pulls enemies in.

name: Flood
note: It slows everything in a wide patch; it does not fill the room's low ground with swimmable water.
text: Floods the low ground for a while.

name: Dissolve
note: Skips armour and opens anything in the group `dissolvable`; the world's weak gates and grates arrive with the new areas (F2). It does not corrode your own held parts.
text: Eats through a weak gate, grate or armour plate.

name: Contagion
text: Poison jumps between enemies standing close.

name: Network
note: It slows enemies on a creeping patch; it does not show the shortest route to a mark.
text: A growth spreads along the floor and slows enemies on it.

name: Guardian
note: A patrol aura that hurts what comes near; it has no visible nail that drains you when hit.
text: A patrol aura that hurts what comes near.

name: Engulf
note: It stuns the enemy where it stands and digests it; the enemy is not drawn inside the body.
text: Swallows a small enemy and holds it while it digests.

name: Ride
note: A plain glide: the fall slows for a moment; no cloud is drawn and it does not carry you sideways.
text: A short glide on a cloud.

name: Recall
note: The first cast lays a mark; the second puts you back on it in one step, not along a walked trail.
text: Lay a trail, then return along it to its start.

name: Shed
note: A husk is left and you slip away untouchable for a moment; enemies are not drawn to the husk, and it is not gone until you rest.
text: Leave a husk decoy and slip away.

name: Court
note: Three allies fight for ten seconds; they cannot be hurt, so the court does not die in one hit.
text: Spawns a few lesser slimes that fight for you.

name: Stalk
note: A stack of one-way steps appears at once; it is not a vine you hold, and it does not grow slowly.
text: Grow a climbable vine from the floor.
